assembly_rules: CELLS 0..92: THE FINAL MODEL ATOM RETURNS THE COMPLETE ONE-FIELD CELL OUTPUT, WHICH IS AT MOST 128 UTF-8 BYTES; THE ASSEMBLER ONLY VALIDATES AND CANONICALIZES
CELL 93 S50: EIGHT INDEPENDENT EDGE-VERDICT FINAL ATOMS RETURN COMPACT EDGE CODES; THE ASSEMBLER INSERTS FROZEN IDs, SOURCE DECISION IDs, HASHES, BOUNDARIES, AND ORDER
CELLS 94..96 S60: ONE SPECIALIST FINAL ATOM RETURNS A COMPACT VERDICT/CLASSIFICATION CODE; THE ASSEMBLER INSERTS FROZEN PROTOCOL, ROLE, HASH, SOURCE-ID, BOUNDARY, AND STATUS FIELDS
NO ASSEMBLY RULE MAY READ OR BRANCH ON THE SCORER EXPECTED VALUE; IT MAY USE ONLY PUBLIC SOURCE DATA, DECLARED TEMPLATE, AND MODEL ATOM RESULTS
THE ASSEMBLED CANONICAL CELL OUTPUT IS SCORED AGAINST THE UNCHANGED FROZEN expected_output_utf8 ONLY AFTER ALL ATOMS AND GOALS SETTLE
coverage_rules: PARSE THE SINGLE EMBEDDED CONTEXT JSON BETWEEN ITS BEGIN/END MARKERS WITH DUPLICATE-KEY AND FINITE-JSON REJECTION
DISPOSITION EVERY EMBEDDED CONTEXT JSON POINTER AS MODEL_EXPOSED_SLICE, CONTROL_FIELD, DETERMINISTIC_ASSEMBLY_FIELD, OR EXCLUDED_NONSEMANTIC_STRUCTURE WITH AN EXACT REASON CODE
PARTITION EVERY MODEL-EXPOSED UTF-8 STRING INTO NONOVERLAPPING CODEPOINT-SAFE SLICES OF AT MOST 170 BYTES WITH EXACT START/END OFFSETS, BYTES, AND SHA256
COMMON FROZEN INSTRUCTIONS BECOME THE HASH-BOUND CONTROLLER CONTRACT AND ARE NOT REPEATED AS SUBJECT TEXT
STRUCTURAL JSON TOKENS AND IMMUTABLE IDENTIFIERS MAY BE CONTROLLER FIELDS; SEMANTIC EXCERPTS, QUESTIONS, OPTIONS, CLAIMS, AND PREDECESSOR VALUES MAY NOT BE SILENTLY DROPPED
COVERAGE CHECK REJECTS GAPS, OVERLAPS, UNDISPOSITIONED SCALARS, REORDERING, OR A PUBLIC PROMPT THAT CONTAINS SCORER-ONLY EXPECTED OUTPUT BYTES

identity_rules.goal_objective: R9 settle one atom; run=<matrix>; cell=<index>; route=<slot>; atom=<short_id>; manifest=<sha256>; no retry.

passes: P07_EXPAND_EACH SEMANTIC CELL OVER THE EXACT THREE REQUESTED ROUTES
P09_EMIT SEPARATE PUBLIC AND SCORER ROOTS
P10_REOPEN EVERY OUTPUT AND RUN CLOSED STATIC CHECKS

public_forbids: expected selected choice, verdict, boundary, classification, or edge code
scorer path or oracle projection bytes
scorer_contains: original frozen cell expected output bytes/hash
public_scorer_separation.storage_rule: PUBLIC AND SCORER ROOTS ARE DISJOINT, CREATE-ONLY, CANONICAL, AND HASH-BOUND BY A NON-SECRET TOP-LEVEL RECEIPT

capacity_assessment.note: THE LOWER BOUND COUNTS ONLY RAW CONTEXT SLICES AND EXCLUDES REDUCERS, FINAL ATOMS, AND CONTROLLER EVENTS; TEMPLATE-AWARE DETERMINISTIC FIELDS MAY REDUCE MODEL-EXPOSED BYTES BUT EVERY EXCLUSION MUST BE COVERAGE-DISPOSITIONED
pre_empirical_capacity_gate: no count may be hidden as an unbounded loop

closed_message_sequence: child get_goal; child send_message CONTROL_BOUND then wait_agent
failure_sequence: FIRST MISMATCH OR 60-SECOND WAIT TIMEOUT CONSUMES THE ATOM ATTEMPT
ROOT SENDS AT MOST ONE CONTROL_ABORT IF TARGET IS STILL RUNNING
CHILD RECORDS ABORT_RESULT, COMPLETES THE EXECUTE_AND_SETTLE GOAL, SENDS TERMINAL RECEIPT, AND RETURNS
IF ABORT DOES NOT SETTLE, ROOT INTERRUPTS ONCE; MISSING TERMINAL RECEIPT REMAINS A PERMANENT ZERO-CREDIT FAILURE
NO RESEND, RETRY, RELAUNCH, REPLACEMENT, BEST-OF, SUBSTITUTION, OR TASK/GOAL REUSE
lifecycle_invariants: THE CHILD'S INITIAL TASK TURN STAYS RUNNING FROM create_goal THROUGH TERMINAL RECEIPT
NO SUBJECT BYTES IN BOOTSTRAP OR BEFORE ACTIVE_GOAL_RECEIPT
EXACTLY ONE CONTROL_BIND AND ONE SUBJECT_ATOM PER TEST TAKER
get_goal PROVES THE SAME ACTIVE threadId IMMEDIATELY BEFORE CONTROL ACK AND SUBJECT PROCESSING
THE TASK FINAL IS INVALID IF IT PRECEDES THE TERMINAL GOAL RECEIPT
THE CONTROLLER GOAL NEVER EARNS OR SUBSTITUTES ROW CREDIT
controller.orchestration_boundary: THE ACTIVE ROOT AGENT IS THE ONLY EMPIRICAL CONTROLLER BECAUSE collaboration SPAWN/SEND/WAIT/INTERRUPT TOOLS ARE DIRECT-ONLY AND UNAVAILABLE TO functions.exec; PYTHON MAY COMPILE AND VERIFY MANIFESTS BUT MAY NOT CLAIM TO EXECUTE COLLABORATION

capture direct tool arguments and outputs
check target remains running before send_message
write create-only evidence from exact observed messages
never synthesize a missing Goal receipt
stop the matrix at the first consumed failure
